messages.subject: Cedar — drafting plan for the licence
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Elena,

Let's get the first draft licence out by the end of November. Key structural points to get right:

- Exclusivity even as to Larkmoor, but with the reserved research right Priya asked for, and a clean field carve-out (cosmetics only; everything else reserved).
- Improvements regime: Larkmoor improvements in-field included; Verrell improvements owned by Verrell with a licence-back outside the field.
- Royalty mechanics: 6% / 4% know-how, third-party stacking deduction, minimum annual royalties.
- Liability cap and the usual warranty position — no validity warranty.

Elena, please own the first cut of the schedules (patents, know-how, milestones, financial). James to lead the operative clauses. I'll review before it goes out.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
